# Livros e Revistas Vlex

> A comprehensive Brazilian legal reference library providing annotated codes, labor law precedents, and expert legal textbooks for professionals and scholars.

Livros e Revistas Vlex is a specialized digital collection of Brazilian legal publications, including foundational texts on labor law, civil procedure, administrative law, and international law. The platform aggregates authoritative legal references, judicial precedents, and educational materials from leading Brazilian legal scholars and institutions.

## Key Topics

- Brazilian Law
- Labor Law (CLT)
- Civil Procedure (NCPC)
- Administrative Law
- Public Employee Law
- International Law
- Legal Reference
- Judicial Precedents (TST)
- Public Sector Employment
- Legal Textbooks
- Human Rights
- Collective Labor Rights
- Treaties
- Portuguese Language

## Labor Law & Employment

- [Súmulas, OJs e Precedentes Normativos do TST, por assunto](https://livros-e-revistas.vlex.com.br/source/sumulas-ojs-precedentes-normativos-tst-12893): TST labor law precedents and jurisprudence organized by subject matter
- [O empregado público. 4ª Edição](https://livros-e-revistas.vlex.com.br/source/empregado-publico-4-edi-o-12312): Legal textbook on public employee law and labor regulations by Cavalcante & Neto
- [Cálculos trabalhistas passo a passo](https://livros-e-revistas.vlex.com.br/source/calculos-trabalhistas-passo-passo-13056): Step-by-step guide to labor law calculations and employment procedures

## Civil Procedure & Process Law

- [Código de Processo Civil. Articulado](https://livros-e-revistas.vlex.com.br/source/codigo-processo-civil-articulado-21015): Annotated Civil Procedure Code with legal commentary and NCPC references
- [Teoria Processual Civil - Parte Geral do NCPC](https://livros-e-revistas.vlex.com.br/source/teoria-processual-civil-parte-geral-do-ncpc-21031): Civil procedure theory covering general principles of New Code of Civil Procedure

## Public Law & International Law

- [Curso de Direito Internacional Público](https://livros-e-revistas.vlex.com.br/source/curso-direito-internacional-publico-14136): International public law course covering treaties, human rights and legal responsibility
